request.title: Register your organization
request.intro: An organization (association, cooperative, company, school, public body) can run events and challenges on HelpLab, read their report and work together with its members.
request.who: The request is submitted by the organization's legal representative or by someone they have authorized. If the request is approved, you become its coordinator: you complete the organization's profile and invite the other members.
request.motivationLabel: What the organization does and what it wants to do on HelpLab
request.motivationPlaceholder: At least 30 characters: the organization's activities and the events or challenges you would like to run.
request.submitHint: To submit, enter the organization's name, at least 30 characters of description, and tick the declaration.
request.sent: Request submitted. The HelpLab team will review it and let you know by email; the outcome also stays on this page.
request.declarationError: The declaration text could not be loaded, and the request cannot be sent without it. Please reload the page.
request.pendingNotice: You already have a pending request: you can send another one once the team has replied.
request.historyEmpty: You haven't sent any requests yet.

card.title: My organizations
card.intro: The organizations you belong to on HelpLab.
card.empty: You don't belong to any organization.
card.loadError: Your organizations could not be loaded.

detail.notFound: Organization not found, or you are not a member.
detail.nameNote: The name is the one approved with the request: to change it, write to the HelpLab team.
detail.logoHelp: The address of an image already published online (https://…). It appears in the report of the organization's events.
detail.membersIntro: Who belongs to the organization, and invitations not yet accepted.
detail.inviteHelp: Enter the email or nickname of someone already registered on HelpLab. They join the organization only once they accept the invitation.
detail.stepDownConfirm: Step down as coordinator? You stay in the organization as a member: another coordinator can make you coordinator again.
detail.leaveConfirm: Leave the organization «{{name}}»? To rejoin you will need a new invitation.
detail.lastReferentNote: You are the only coordinator: to leave, first make another member coordinator.
detail.membersLoadError: The members could not be loaded.
detail.challengesIntroReferent: Challenges proposed on behalf of the organization. You can change title, place, description and deadline; type, targets and status are managed by the HelpLab team.
detail.challengesIntroMember: Challenges proposed on behalf of the organization. The texts are edited by the coordinators.
detail.challengesEmpty: No challenges yet. Propose one from «Create a challenge», choosing «on behalf of the organization».
detail.challengesLoadError: I can't load the organization's challenges.
detail.adminIntro: To give the organization challenges and events that already exist, for example those organised before the organization was registered.
detail.adminNoEvents: No events of the organization among the 100 most recent.
detail.adminEventHelp: An ended event can be assigned if it has no organization, but not changed. A published event with consents already given does not change organization.
detail.adminChallengeHelp: Among the 50 most recently updated challenges without an organization.
detail.adminUnassignConfirm: Remove «{{title}}» from the organization? The challenge stays, without organization.
detail.adminListsError: I can't load the challenges and events to assign.

choice.label: On behalf of
choice.helpEvent: With an organization, all its members can see and edit the event, and the public page shows the organization as organiser.
choice.helpProposal: With an organization, once approved the challenge belongs to it: its coordinators edit the texts and members link it to the organization's events.
choice.loadError: I can't load your organizations: for now you can only act on your own behalf.

challengeEdit.title: Edit challenge
challengeEdit.subtitle: Challenge of the organization «{{name}}»
challengeEdit.notFound: Challenge not found among the organization's, or you are not a member.
challengeEdit.notAllowed: The challenge texts are edited by the organization's coordinators.
challengeEdit.scopeNote: Here you change title, place, description and deadline. Type, targets and status are managed by the HelpLab team, because they decide impact and points.
challengeEdit.rulesHelp: Shown on the public challenge card.

sponsors.title: Sponsor proposals
sponsors.intro: Companies offering to support one of the organisation's events. HelpLab reviews them only after a referent says yes: the first one to answer decides for the organisation.
sponsors.empty: No sponsorship proposals for the organisation's events.
sponsors.loadError: The proposals could not be loaded.
sponsors.onlyReferents: Proposals are answered by the organisation's referents.
sponsors.acceptText: You accept {{sponsor}}'s proposal for the event “{{event}}” on behalf of the organisation. After your yes the HelpLab team reviews it and agrees the payment with the sponsor.
sponsors.acceptConfirm: I accept on behalf of the organisation
sponsors.declineText: You decline {{sponsor}}'s proposal for the event “{{event}}” on behalf of the organisation. The proposal is closed and does not go to HelpLab.
sponsors.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Thank you, this event already has its supporters.
sponsors.messageHelp: The sponsor reads it. Without a message they read “The organising body has declined the proposal”.
sponsors.declineConfirm: I decline on behalf of the organisation
sponsors.acceptedNotice: You accepted {{sponsor}}'s proposal: HelpLab will now review it.
